project_info.color_palette: Deep matte blue, cream white, blueberry navy, warm violet, mint green

main_subject.detail: A deep matte-blue plastic protein drink bottle, centered in a three-quarter view and tilted slightly right, with condensation and a visible milk & yogurt mock up protein label.
main_subject.style: Hyper-real AI-edited commercial beverage photography with frozen high-speed motion

composition_elements.text: milk & yogurt mock up protein; SEPARATED SHADOWS
items: Center: deep-blue protein bottle with condensation and readable mock-up label.
Around base and sides: creamy white and light-beige milk splash rising in twisting peaks.
Foreground and midair: whole and halved blueberries, white droplets, and small mint leaves.
Background: violet-to-blue gradient with warm rim glow and floating particles.
Base: wet dark surface with scattered berries and cream residue.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Controlled highlights, dramatic warm-blue rim light, frozen splashes, micro-droplet clarity, and separated shadows

assets.name: protein drink bottle and label
assets.usage: Preserve the bottle profile, cap, matte-blue color, label hierarchy, and product typography.

assets.name: milk & yogurt mock-up label
assets.usage: Keep all visible label wording accurate and sharp.

prompt_instructions: Attach the exact packaging and label artwork.
Keep bottle scale dominant and the label undistorted.
Treat blueberries and cream as supporting ingredients, never obscure the core label.
